title: Blossoming Stars

outfit_card.silhouette: Floor-length empire A-line gown with delicate off-the-shoulder draped straps, a structured boned bodice, and a vertical pleated flowing tulle skirt radiating soft pastoral elegance.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Delicate golden floral pins with dangling petal charms tucked into a braided updo, paired with matching bell-shaped gold blossom drop earrings.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Pastel green sweetheart bodice draped with sheer off-the-shoulder bands, intricately embroidered with golden starburst floras, vertical micro-pearl ribbing, and a filigree gold blossom collar necklace.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Cascading A-line chiffon skirt finely gathered with vertical crystal-and-pearl strand cascades, dusted with three-dimensional pale yellow blossom appliqués scattering gracefully toward the sweeping floor-grazing hem.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Three-dimensional star-shaped blossom appliqués, cascading vertical pearl strands, golden floral wristlets, and shimmering woodland petal motifs.
